en.hero_title: Your construction site, on your phone.
en.hero_lede: Deliveries, stores, payments, progress and people, each recorded on site with a photo, a name and a time. The owner and the builder see the same facts, every day.

en.origin: Born on a real building site, not in an office.
en.who_title: Made for everyone on the build

who.d: Building your own house? See every delivery, payment and stage without standing on site all day.
Run several client sites with one team, and show every client progress they can trust.
Working in the Gulf while your house goes up back home? Follow the site, approve payments and see photos from anywhere.
Supervisors and store keepers record deliveries, releases and attendance in seconds, with big buttons and site cards.

en.tabs_title: Everything that happens on site, in one place
en.leaks_title: Stop the usual leaks on a building site
en.leaks_lede: Material walks off, bills grow and work slips when the only record is a notebook and a few WhatsApp photos. Buildiary puts a photo, a name and a time on every step.

leaks.s: Site cards with a PIN, a face check against the registered photo, and the phone's location for attendance.
Every bag is received against an order and released to a named person, with photos at each step.
Quotations are locked before an order is raised, and you pay only what is due, with a receipt for every payment.
Each stage shows planned against built, with a daily site diary and behind-plan stages flagged on the dashboard.

en.tools_title: One app for the whole build

tools.d: Quotations locked as final before an order is raised.
Stock, low-stock alerts and every movement of an item.
Pay only what is due, with a receipt for every payment.
Budget by phase and a cash-flow forecast for the project.
Given, spent and returned by person, with bills.
Stages with planned dates and percentage built.
What happened on site today, with photos.
Checks, defects and who fixes them.
QR site cards, a PIN and a face check.
Every tanker with its size and TDS reading.
Plain questions, answers from your live records.
Account statements to send on WhatsApp.

en.cur_lede: Buildiary counts in Pakistani rupees, Saudi riyals, UAE dirhams, Qatari riyals or US dollars, and speaks English, Urdu and Arabic.
en.band_title: Build with the facts in your pocket
en.band_lede: 7 days free. No card. Your workspace is ready in about a minute.

ar.origin: وُلد في موقع بناء حقيقي، لا في مكتب.

who.d: تبني بيتك؟ تابع كل توريد ودفعة ومرحلة دون أن تقف في الموقع طوال اليوم.
أدِر عدة مواقع لعملائك بفريق واحد، واعرض على كل عميل تقدّماً يثق به.
تعمل في الخليج وبيتك يُبنى في بلدك؟ تابع الموقع واعتمد الدفعات وشاهد الصور من أي مكان.
المشرف وأمين المخزن يسجّلان التوريدات والصرف والحضور في ثوانٍ، بأزرار كبيرة وبطاقات الموقع.

ar.tabs_title: كل ما يحدث في الموقع، في مكان واحد
ar.leaks_title: أوقف الخسائر المعتادة في موقع البناء
ar.leaks_lede: تختفي المواد وتكبر الفواتير ويتأخر العمل حين يكون السجل دفتراً وبضع صور على واتساب. بلدائري يضع صورة واسماً ووقتاً على كل خطوة.

leaks.s: بطاقات موقع برقم سري، ومطابقة الوجه مع الصورة المسجّلة، وموقع الجوال عند تسجيل الحضور.
كل كيس يُستلم مقابل أمر شراء ويُصرف لشخص باسمه، مع صور في كل خطوة.
يُعتمد عرض السعر نهائياً قبل أمر الشراء، وتدفع المستحق فقط، مع إيصال لكل دفعة.
كل مرحلة تُظهر المخطّط مقابل المنفّذ، مع يومية الموقع، والمراحل المتأخرة تظهر على لوحة المتابعة.
